title: Close-up witnesses sensed being watched

tellings.quote: I've had some folks I talked to that had their own kind of up close kind of sightings. They said that they got that vibe, too,

plain: People who saw these objects up close have said they had a feeling of being watched, according to David Grusch, a former US intelligence official. Grusch says he has talked to several such witnesses who told him they "got that vibe, too", which he shares as backing for the same feeling. If true, it would suggest the objects are somehow aware of the people seeing them.
